table.name: california_school_cohort_outcomes_2014_2015
table.purpose: One row per California public school (grades with a graduation cohort) for the 2014-2015 academic year, carrying the school's CDS identifiers, classification attributes, and cohort outcome counts and rates (e.g., graduates/dropouts). Structure strongly matches California Department of Education / DataQuest school-level files (CDS code, county-district-school codes, Educational Options type, charter flags, low/high grade, cohort numerators and rates).

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code, the unique identifier of a school; primary key, one-to-one with t03.col_001.

col_002.name: academic_year
col_002.description: Academic year of the record; constant '2014-2015'.

col_003.name: county_code
col_003.description: Two-digit California county code (e.g., 19 = Los Angeles, 37 = San Diego); matches col_006 county names.

col_004.name: district_code
col_004.description: Five-digit district code portion of the CDS code (e.g., 64733 = Los Angeles Unified); matches col_007 district names.

col_005.name: school_code
col_005.description: Seven-digit school code portion of the CDS code; '0000000' (45 rows) denotes district-level/office rows rather than a single school.

col_007.name: district_name
col_007.description: School district / administrative authority name (e.g., 'Los Angeles Unified', county offices of education).

col_008.name: school_name
col_008.description: School (or site) name; 'District Office' for district-level rows.

col_009.name: district_type
col_009.description: Type of administrative authority: Unified/Elementary/High School District, County Office of Education, State Board of Education, Non-School Locations.

col_010.name: educational_option_type
col_010.description: School type by educational option (California 'Educational Options' categories): Elementary/High/Intermediate-Middle Schools (Public), Continuation High Schools, Alternative Schools of Choice, etc.

col_011.name: school_level_type
col_011.description: Coarser school type: Traditional, Continuation School, Alternative School of Choice, Community Day, Special Education, Juvenile Court, Home & Hospital, etc.

col_012.name: nslp_provision_type
col_012.description: National School Lunch Program provision status (Provision 1/2/3, Breakfast Provision 2, CEP = Community Eligibility Provision); null when not applicable.

col_013.name: is_charter_school
col_013.description: Charter school indicator (0/1); ~12% of rows are charters.

col_014.name: charter_school_number
col_014.description: Charter school number (state-assigned), populated only for charter schools (null for ~88% of rows).

col_015.name: charter_funding_type
col_015.description: Charter funding model: 'Directly funded' or 'Locally funded'; populated only for charter schools.

col_016.name: dass_or_alternative_flag
col_016.description: 0/1 flag set for ~7% of rows; plausibly the DASS (Dashboard Alternative School Status) flag for alternative schools whose outcomes are measured differently, but the data alone does not confirm which flag.

col_017.name: low_grade
col_017.description: Lowest grade served, coded with 'K' for kindergarten and numbers otherwise (K, 9, 6, 7, P possibly pre-K).

col_018.name: high_grade
col_018.description: Highest grade served; values 1-13 plus 'K' (13 likely ungraded/adult; K appears anomalous).

col_019.name: cohort_size_total
col_019.description: Total cohort count for the school (denominator of the outcome rates), up to 5333 students.

col_020.name: outcome_1_count
col_020.description: Count of students in the first outcome subgroup (e.g., graduates or dropouts); mean ~312. Exact outcome (graduates vs dropouts vs met-subgroup) cannot be determined from values alone.

col_021.name: outcome_1_rate
col_021.description: Rate/proportion for the first outcome, = col_020 / col_019 (values 0-1, mean ~0.53).

col_022.name: outcome_2_count
col_022.description: Count for a second outcome subgroup (mean ~365); likely a broader count such as graduates including summer completers, but the exact definition is not determinable.

col_023.name: outcome_2_rate
col_023.description: Rate for the second outcome, = col_022 / col_019 (mean ~0.61).

col_024.name: cohort_size_adjusted
col_024.description: A second cohort-size-like count (mean ~605, close to col_019); plausibly the cohort for a second population (e.g., a different grade span or adjusted cohort), but the exact definition is not determinable.

col_025.name: outcome_3_count
col_025.description: Count for a third outcome subgroup relative to col_024 (mean ~304).

col_026.name: outcome_3_rate
col_026.description: Rate for the third outcome, = col_025 / col_024 (mean ~0.53).

col_027.name: outcome_4_count
col_027.description: Count for a fourth outcome subgroup relative to col_024 (mean ~356).

col_028.name: outcome_4_rate
col_028.description: Rate for the fourth outcome, = col_027 / col_024 (mean ~0.61).

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: California school/district-level SAT (or similar standardized college admissions test) results. Each row is either a school ('S') or a district/county-level aggregate ('D') identified by a 14-digit CDS-style code, with test participation counts and average section scores. Joins one-to-one to t03 on the same code.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code uniquely identifying each school or district record; primary key, joins one-to-one to t03.col_001.

col_002.name: record_level
col_002.description: Record level flag: 'S' = school-level record, 'D' = district/aggregate-level record (these have null school name).

col_003.name: school_name
col_003.description: School name; null for district-level ('D') records.

col_004.name: district_name
col_004.description: School district (or county office of education) name.

col_005.name: county_name
col_005.description: California county name (Los Angeles, San Diego, etc.).

col_006.name: enrollment_or_grade_12_students
col_006.description: Count, likely grade-12 enrollment or number of students eligible; mean ~420, max 43,324. Exact definition unresolved.

col_007.name: number_tested
col_007.description: Count of students tested (mean ~185, many zeros for district rows); plausible reading is number of test takers, but could be another participation count.

col_008.name: avg_score_section_1
col_008.description: Average score for a test section (range 308-653, consistent with SAT 200-800 scale), e.g. reading/verbal; null when no scores reported.

col_009.name: avg_score_section_2
col_009.description: Average score for a second section (range 289-699), e.g. math; null when no scores reported.

col_010.name: avg_score_section_3
col_010.description: Average score for a third section (range 312-671), e.g. writing; null when no scores reported.

col_011.name: number_with_scores
col_011.description: Count, likely number of students with reported scores (mean ~111, max 5,837); exact definition unresolved.

table.name: california_public_schools_directory
table.purpose: Directory of California public schools and district/COE-run educational entities (CDE-style schools table). One row per school/site, identified by its 14-digit CDS code. Referenced one-to-one by t01 and t02, which likely hold per-school measures (e.g., enrollment/staffing).

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit County-District-School (CDS) code; unique primary key. First 2 digits county, next 5 district, last 7 school.

col_002.name: district_code
col_002.description: 7-digit administrative district (LEA) code the school belongs to; e.g. 0622710 = Los Angeles Unified.

col_003.name: school_code
col_003.description: 5-digit school code within its district (part of the CDS code). Null for district-level/COE-wide rows.

col_004.name: status_type
col_004.description: School operational status: Active, Closed, Merged, or Pending.

col_005.name: county
col_005.description: County name (California counties: Los Angeles, Butte, Marin, etc.).

col_006.name: district
col_006.description: District / LEA name (e.g. 'Los Angeles Unified', 'Butte County Office of Education').

col_007.name: school
col_007.description: School or site name (e.g. 'Lincoln Elementary', 'Fresno COE District-Wide Preschool').

col_008.name: street_address
col_008.description: Physical street address, spelled-out street suffixes ('Road', 'Street').

col_009.name: street_address_abbrev
col_009.description: Physical street address with abbreviated suffixes ('Rd.', 'St.'), same address as col_008.

col_011.name: zip
col_011.description: Physical address ZIP code, sometimes with ZIP+4.

col_013.name: mailing_street_address
col_013.description: Mailing street address (may differ from physical; e.g. PO Box).

col_014.name: mailing_street_address_abbrev
col_014.description: Mailing street address with abbreviated suffixes, same as col_013.

col_016.name: mailing_zip
col_016.description: Mailing address ZIP code, sometimes ZIP+4.

col_018.name: phone
col_018.description: School main phone number, formatted '(area) nnn-nnnn'.

col_021.name: open_date
col_021.description: Date the school opened. Values appear shifted (dominant value 2036-07-01, min 1906-07-01), likely a two-digit-century/parsing artifact; true dates are decades earlier. Null for ~8% of rows.

col_022.name: close_date
col_022.description: Date the school closed; null for most (open) schools, present for Closed/Merged rows. Same apparent date-shift as col_021.

col_024.name: charter_number
col_024.description: Charter school number, populated only for charter schools (~10% of rows).

col_025.name: charter_funding_type
col_025.description: Charter funding model: Directly funded / Locally funded / Not in CS funding model; populated only for charters.

col_026.name: district_type_code
col_026.description: Two-digit code for the district/LEA type; 00 = County Office of Education, 54 = Unified, 52 = Elementary, 56 = High School district.

col_027.name: district_type
col_027.description: Label of col_026: Unified/Elementary/High School District, COE, ROC/P, JPA, Community College District, etc.

col_028.name: school_type_code
col_028.description: Two-digit code for the school type/level of operation (60 = elementary, 66 = high school, 62 = middle, 09 = special ed).

col_029.name: school_type
col_029.description: Label of col_028: Elementary/High/Intermediate-Middle Schools (Public), Continuation High, Special Education Schools, etc.

col_030.name: educational_option_code
col_030.description: Code for educational option type: TRAD (traditional), CON (continuation), COMMDAY (community day), ALTSOC, SPEC, ROP, JUV, etc.

col_031.name: educational_option
col_031.description: Label of col_030: Traditional, Continuation School, Community Day School, Juvenile Court School, etc.

col_032.name: grade_span_category_code
col_032.description: Code for grade-span grouping: ELEM, HS, UG (ungraded), INTMIDJR, ELEMHIGH, A (adult), PS (preschool).

col_033.name: grade_span_category
col_033.description: Label of col_032: Elementary, High School, Ungraded, Intermediate/Middle/Junior High, Elementary-High Combination, Adult.

col_034.name: low_grade
col_034.description: Lowest grade served, e.g. 'K-5' means low grade K; values like 'K', '9', '10', 'P' (preschool).

col_035.name: high_grade
col_035.description: Highest grade served, e.g. 'K-5' means high grade 5; values like '5', '12', 'K'.

col_038.name: latitude
col_038.description: School location latitude (decimal degrees); range 32.5–44.2 matches California.

col_039.name: longitude
col_039.description: School location longitude (decimal degrees); range -124.3 to -83.8, mostly -120s, matches California.

col_040.name: admin_first_name
col_040.description: First name of the school's administrator/contact (e.g. principal).

col_041.name: admin_last_name
col_041.description: Last name of the school's administrator/contact.

col_042.name: admin_email
col_042.description: Email address of the school's administrator/contact.

col_043.name: contact2_first_name
col_043.description: First name of a second contact (populated for ~2% of rows); specific role unknown.

col_044.name: contact2_last_name
col_044.description: Last name of the second contact.

col_046.name: contact3_first_name
col_046.description: First name of a third contact (only ~40 rows); specific role unknown.

col_047.name: contact3_last_name
col_047.description: Last name of the third contact.

col_049.name: last_reviewed_date
col_049.description: Date the record was last reviewed/updated (dominant values 2055-06-24 and 2071-06-18 suggest bulk updates; same apparent date-shift as col_021).
